experiences.name: Prague Old Town & Astronomical Clock Tour
experiences.description: Arrive in Prague by early afternoon and dive straight into the heart of the city. Explore the medieval Old Town Square, watch the famous Astronomical Clock chime on the hour, and wander through Gothic alleyways. A self-guided walk keeps costs low while maximizing your first full day of culture and history.

experiences.name: Prague Castle Complex & St. Vitus Cathedral
experiences.description: Spend a morning exploring the largest ancient castle complex in the world. Walk through the Royal Palace, marvel at the Gothic grandeur of St. Vitus Cathedral, and enjoy panoramic views over the red rooftops of Prague. Book tickets in advance to save time and money.

experiences.name: Budapest Thermal Bath Experience at Széchenyi
experiences.description: After city hopping from Prague to Budapest, unwind in one of Europe's most iconic thermal bath complexes. The neo-baroque Széchenyi Baths offer indoor and outdoor pools fed by natural hot springs, a perfect cultural and restorative experience deeply rooted in Hungarian history and tradition.

experiences.name: Budapest Ruin Bar Crawl in the Jewish Quarter
experiences.description: Explore Budapest's unique ruin bar scene, born from abandoned buildings transformed into eclectic cultural and social hubs. Start at the legendary Szimpla Kert and wander through the historic Jewish Quarter, soaking in street art, local craft beers, and the vibrant nightlife that defines modern Budapest culture.

experiences.name: Buda Castle Hill & Hungarian National History Walk
experiences.description: Climb or take the historic funicular up to Buda Castle Hill for sweeping views of the Danube and Pest skyline. Visit the Budapest History Museum, stroll along Fisherman's Bastion, and explore Matthias Church. This half-day itinerary packs centuries of Hungarian history into one walkable hilltop district.
